summary: test(ci): measure per-process heap in fresh builds; add an uncached switch
description:
Because:

- We need to know how close build tasks get to their heap limit before lowering it

This commit:

- Preloads a heap probe that records each Node process's peak heap, limit and RSS
- Runs two fresh p4 builds with a 4GB limit, also probing settings' webpack builds
- Adds a bench_uncached pipeline parameter that sets NX_SKIP_NX_CACHE in all jobs
